title: How to Trick Your Brain Into Liking Discipline
description:
Most people think they lack discipline, but the truth is much deeper. In this video, we break down why your brain is wired to resist effort, how your environment is silently sabotaging you, and how to redesign your habits using proven psychological principles. Stop relying on motivation — start using systems.

Reference:
Based on Atomic Habits by James Clear.
